items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: I always say if I had to start a team of all the players the Lakers have had, Magic Johnson would be my first choice of anybody in the NBA to start a team.

ctx.x: I don’t know whether I would take Kevin Durant over Larry Bird but it’s kind of frightening. But I always say if I had to start a team of all the players the Lakers have had, Magic Johnson would be my first choice of anybody in the NBA to start a team. Because he made everybody better.
